visual.description: Full QuadrantScatter at 100% — all 33 dots visible, all quadrant labels, all quadrant fills. This is the 'hero shot' — the complete picture. All spotlight labels (Luxembourg, Japan, USA, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Mexico) visible. Brief wide-angle hold for 2-3 seconds. Then slow zoom begins toward the space between USA (GRIND) and Denmark (DREAM).

notes: The hero shot — everything the viewer has been building toward. Let it breathe for 2-3 seconds before the zoom starts. Very slow camera zoom (12s total, continues into Scene 015) targeting the midpoint between USA and Denmark. Ambient dot pulse is barely perceptible (0.5% scale) — adds life without distraction. All 33 dots from all quadrants visible with their assigned colors.
